title: Marathon Will Have A Free Test For Everyone Before Launch
description: If you're curious about Bungie's new shooter Marathon and worried about plunking down $40, Bungie has some welcome news. There will be an "open preview weekend" for the game ahead of launch. Bungie confirmed this on social media, writing, "We'll have an open preview weekend before launch, and everyone will be able to try Marathon out." The wording here suggests this will be free. Marathon has endured multiple controversies already, with Bungie settling a case after art plagiarism allegations, while the studio has also faced questions about whether games like Marathon are remnants of the past. In GameSpot's preview of Marathon from April 2025, GameSpot's Tamoor Hussain said, "A paid game that is light on content but full of hopes, dreams, and ambitions may not be enough to inspire in others the same confidence I have in Bungie." Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: New Battlefield 6 Season 2 Map Revealed
description: Before Battlefield 6 Season 2 was pushed back to February 17, the season would have begun today, January 21. While Battlefield 6 players are still waiting to learn what's coming in the new season, a leak on Reddit has revealed that one of the maps is Hagental Airbase in Bravia. In the leaked trailer, NATO forces have lost control of Hagental Airbase, and the voiceover warns that they need to take it back or the momentum of the war will go against them. Some fans on Reddit have complained about the apparent size of the map, and that the airbase doesn't appear to allow jets in battle. Separately, Battlefield 6's social channels revealed Contaminated, a new map for the game that's going to be dropped in Battlefield Labs before it debuts in the primary game. Battlefield Studios also confirmed that it will arrive during Season 2. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Super Mario Galaxy Movie's Chris Pratt Says Trailers So Far Haven't Shown All The Characters
description: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie hasn't revealed all of its secrets just yet. Mario voice actor Chris Pratt has teased that, while trailers so far have featured characters not seen in the first movie like Rosalina and Bowser Jr., fans still haven't seen every character who will be in the sequel. Pratt told GamesRadar that there are multiple new characters who weren't in the 2023 movie that he's excited to see in the next movie. "I'm not allowed to say what they are, but yes, there are some really incredible ... Well, I think some of them have been released in the trailer--Rosalina, Bowser Jr.--and then there's even a couple more that are not in the trailer that people should be excited to see," Pratt said. The Super Mario Galaxy Movie releases in theaters in April 2026. It has massive shoes to fill, as 2023's The Super Mario Bros. Movie earned $1.36 billion worldwide. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Xbox January Update Includes Easier Game-Save Syncs And Arm-PC Support
description: The Xbox PC app, and a majority of Xbox Game Pass PC titles, will now work on Arm-based Windows 11 PCs, Microsoft has announced. The news comes as part of a blog detailing various updates across the Xbox ecosystem this month. Recent improvements like changes to the Prism emulator that runs x86/x64 software on Arm devices to support AVX and AVX2, as well as Epic Anti-Cheat support, means more modern games are now capable of running on Arm-based Windows PC devices, according to Microsoft. While not all games will work, Xbox states more than 85% of titles available on Game Pass will, and that it is working with partners to further expand that number. Games that are not yet supported to run locally can still be played on Arm-based devices using Xbox Cloud Gaming. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Among Us TV Show Gets A Critical Production Update That Should Make Fans Happy

As part of Innersloth's 2026 roadmap, the developer said, "It's not dead okay, don't worry." That's all the studio had to say on the matter, so it is not much to go on. However, the assurance that the show remains in the works is something. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: Marathon Preorders Included A Forced Destiny 2 Download, But It's Fixed Now
description: Preorders for Bungie's new shooter Marathon went live this week, but things did not go entirely to plan for the PC version on Steam. People reported that upon preordering Marathon on Steam, they also got Destiny 2 automatically installed without any prompting. This was an issue that Bungie has now fixed, the developer said. Additionally, Bungie said it fixed an issue with the Collector's Edition that caused players to get an error when trying to activate game codes on Steam. People who buy Marathon before release get free cosmetics for Destiny 2, and some theorized this could be related to the issue. However, Bungie did not explain why or how these issues occurred. Continue Reading at GameSpot

title: WoW's New Damage Meter Is, By Design, Worse Than What Add-Ons Can Offer
description: New World of Warcraft user-interface additions like its built-in damage meter aren't intended to offer all the bells and whistles that player-made mods (aka add-ons) provide, Blizzard has said in a new interview. The pre-patch for the upcoming Midnight expansion went live January 20, and with it came major additions to WoW's base user interface that are meant to provide some of the core utility Blizzard once relied on add-ons to provide, as well as changes to what add-ons are allowed to do when it comes to aiding in combat. Those new additions include a boss timeline and damage meter meant to serve as substitutes to extremely popular add-ons like Deadly Boss Mods and Details! respectively. Both add-ons collectively have been downloaded more than 900 million times, according to add-on manager Curse Forge. Many players have long viewed both as practically mandatory in order to play the game effectively. Continue Reading at GameSpot
